records.topic: 2020 85 SX troubleshooting table (owner's manual)
records.statement: KTM's 2020 85 SX owner's manual troubleshooting table covers: engine overheating (low coolant, too little airflow, dirty radiator fins, foaming coolant, damaged head or head gasket, bent radiator hose); white smoke or steam in the exhaust from a damaged cylinder head or head gasket; water in the oil from a damaged radial shaft seal ring or water pump; oil coming out of the vent hose from overfilling; wrong ignition timing from a loose stator; stalling or popping from lack of fuel, an intake air leak, or a loose/oxidized ignition connector; power loss from a leaking or deformed exhaust or packed-out silencer; low power from a very dirty air filter.

records.notes: Generic factory troubleshooting rather than a field-failure report; listed so riders can match symptoms to the factory's stated causes.

records.topic: 2027 FC 350 map selection and rider aids (owner's manual)
records.statement: Husqvarna's 2027 FC 350 owner's manual: the left-bar combination switch selects STANDARD (balanced response, button 1) or ADVANCED (direct response, button 2) mapping below 4,000 rpm; traction control (TC button) can be added to either map and stays as last set at restart; launch control is armed at idle in neutral by holding TC and QS together; it caps full-throttle rpm off the start and switches off a few seconds after the start or if the throttle is closed past one third; the quickshifter (QS button) gives clutchless upshifts except 1st to 2nd; downshifts still need the clutch.

records.topic: 2027 FC 450 map selection and rider aids (owner's manual)
records.statement: Husqvarna's 2027 FC 450 owner's manual: the left-bar combination switch selects STANDARD (balanced response, button 1) or ADVANCED (direct response, button 2) mapping below 4,000 rpm; traction control (TC button) can be added to either map and stays as last set at restart; launch control is armed at idle in neutral by holding TC and QS together; it caps full-throttle rpm off the start and switches off a few seconds after the start or if the throttle is closed past one third; the quickshifter (QS button) gives clutchless upshifts except 1st to 2nd; downshifts still need the clutch.

records.topic: 2027 MC 450F troubleshooting table (owner's manual)
records.statement: GasGas's 2027 MC 450F owner's manual troubleshooting table covers: engine overheating (low coolant, too little airflow, dirty radiator fins, foaming coolant, damaged head or head gasket, bent radiator hose); high oil consumption (bent engine vent hose, oil level too high, oil too thin, worn piston or cylinder, leaking engine case); malfunction indicator lamp on or flashing (fuel-injection fault: check wiring and connectors for corrosion, read the fault memory with the diagnostics tool); no start or low power from a clogged fuel screen in the quick-lock fuel coupling; power loss from a leaking or deformed exhaust or packed-out silencer; low power from a very dirty air filter or fuel filter/screen.

source.name: GASGAS Owner's Manual 2027 (2027 MC 450F), item no. 3215291en

records.notes: Generic factory troubleshooting rather than a field-failure report; listed so riders can match symptoms to the factory's stated causes.
